about_the_game:
WildRise: Transform the World

When nature fell silent and concrete conquered all, a Forest Guardian named Floofi slumbered through centuries of decay. Now awakened to a world of gray towers and buried soil, this unlikely hero needs your help to crack through the concrete and resurrect the wild.

A Deceptively Deep Puzzle Experience

What starts innocent becomes legendary. Place mushrooms, match flowers, help an adorable guardian restore nature—sounds simple, right?

🌿 Strong Core Mechanics
Match nature elements by color or type to transform lifeless concrete into thriving ecosystems. The rules take minutes to learn, but the mastery will consume you.

🧩 Strategic Depth
Those helpful wildcards and clearing bombs? They evolve from conveniences into surgical instruments of survival. Every placement matters when concrete fights back.

⚡ Progressive Challenge
Early levels teach you to walk. Later environments will demand you fly. The difficulty curve rewards growth while respecting your time.

🏛️ Hidden Depths
Ancient monuments scattered throughout hold secrets that only the most dedicated puzzle masters will unlock. Some mysteries run deeper than restoring nature itself.

🌍 Complete World Transformation
Watch entire landscapes bloom from wasteland to paradise. Each solved puzzle brings forests to life, flowers to bloom, and ancient magic back to the world.

Everyone thinks they understand WildRise after the first few levels. The forest has other plans.

Join Floofi's mission. Crack the concrete. Restore the wild.

Will you become the guardian this world needs?
